title: micromeria graeca subsp. micrantha
intro: Micromeria graeca subsp. micrantha, commonly known as Mountain mint, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Lamiaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, with potential health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects, which can aid in the treatment of various conditions such as digestive issues, respiratory problems, and skin irritations. The therapeutic actions of Mountain mint are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve headaches, and soothe respiratory issues, among other uses. The bioactive constituents of Mountain mint include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been studied for their potential in developing new therapeutic agents.
